case.title: The Cruise Ship Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Aurora Voyager, the loss of a secret new machine has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The loss of a secret new machine
case.target_fake_identity: Daniel Reyes, a retired government worker people trust
case.escape_plan: Daniel Reyes plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

The alarm goes off. No one may leave.

evidence.name: a page from an account book
evidence.description: A page of numbers that do not add up.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a photo
evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

hidden_clues: Daniel Reyes's story about where they were does not match the a page from an account book.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.
red_herrings: a cloth with blood on it

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a retired government worker
solution.reasoning: Daniel Reyes is the hidden person. The main clues (a page from an account book, muddy shoes) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: Among the 6 people at The Aurora Voyager, one is not who they claim to be. Find the clue that breaks their alibi and name the person behind the loss of a secret new machine. No hints here. Trust only the clues that fit together.
